Game Overview

At its heart, Chinese Food Cooking Game is a cooking game about embark on a culinary adventure to dominate the kitchen with traditional Chinese recipes, from dumplings to hotpot. Race against time to serve street-food delights, juggle orders efficiently, and build your restaurant empire. Perfect for aspiring chefs who crave fast-paced cooking challenges and a taste of authentic Chinese cuisine!
